metadata.title: Risewell | Helping Each Other Make a Better Today
metadata.description: Join Risewell to support education, healthcare, and community programs that give every child a fair chance.

hero.eyebrow: Start Donating for a Better Tomorrow
hero.lead: Join our monthly giving program to provide consistent support to our initiatives. Regular contributions, no matter the size, help us plan and sustain long-term projects.

about.title: Do More Together Than You Can Alone.
about.text: We are a people-driven non-profit organization committed to creating meaningful change in underprivileged communities. Through collective support, we work to provide education, healthcare, and a better quality of life for those in need.
about.image_alt: Girl washing her hands at a tap
about.image_front_alt: Boy holding a save the planet sign

services.title: Our Work for a
services.lead: We focus on key areas that create lasting, meaningful change in people's lives and help build stronger, healthier, and more inclusive communities.

items.title: Education Support
items.text: Providing learning opportunities and resources for a brighter future.

items.text: Improving access to basic healthcare and wellness services.

items.title: Community Development
items.text: Empowering communities through sustainable and inclusive initiatives.

items.title: Environmental Care
items.text: Promoting a cleaner, greener and healthier environment for all.

items.title: Food & Basic Needs
items.text: Supporting underprivileged families with essential supplies and nutrition.

items.title: Women Empowerment
items.text: Creating opportunities for women through skills, support and self-reliance.

items.title: Disaster Relief

items.title: Child Welfare
items.text: Ensuring safety, care and better opportunities for every child.
